text:
**Card spending:** Monzo doesn’t charge a foreign-transaction fee. It converts at Mastercard’s exchange rate.

**Cash withdrawals:** Fee-free amounts depend on where you are and your account:

- **In the UK or EEA** (EU countries, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway): withdrawals are unlimited and fee-free if Monzo is your main bank or you have an eligible paid plan. Otherwise, you get **£400 fee-free per rolling 30 days**, then a **3% fee**.
- **Outside the UK and EEA:** the fee-free allowance is **£200 per rolling 30 days** for standard accounts, **£400** for Plus, and **£600** for Premium, Perks or Max. After that, Monzo charges **3%**.

An ATM may also charge its own fee. If it asks whether to charge you in pounds or the local currency, choose **local currency** to avoid the ATM’s conversion rate. ([Monzo’s fee guide](https://monzo.com/help/account-and-profile/understanding-fees))
